gates_before_real_model_calls: Complete shared semantic mapping and applicable data-use/version qualification
Hash-pinned spatial/label/context role plan and independent batch audit
Concrete runtime/cost profile and prior budget/time notice under existing user authorization

roles.source_selection: Original exposed source devval subset only
roles.target_development_validation: Original exposed target devval subset only; no independent holdout/confirmation claim

geometry.context: Same clipped7x7 patches for all proposed model arms; original tile boundary enforced with replicated edges
geometry.whole_tile_vs_patch: A separate whole-tile arm would require its own context/exposure accounting and cannot be labeled matched-context.
geometry.normalization: Each original bank's frozen training-only statistics, not refitted on common-class subset or target validation

supports.membership: Subsets of the already published K5/V5 identities, no new labels or role promotion
supports.many_to_one_mapping: If a source class merge supplies more thanK, freeze deterministic hash-ranked selection before any fit. Do not choose via accuracy.

model.reference: Existing project native shared spectral-adapter/CNN/local-graph comparator, prior source395caef57fba8ab6a09223538f748179dab552f2; no default change
model.configuration: Prior native64/32 GroupNorm learned graph with residual/coverage/interaction none; exact input/head mapping must be registered after taxonomy closure
model.physical_metadata: No claim that historical approximate wavelength vectors authenticate native detectors or SRF

arms.source: Same source observations/class counts, fixed seed512 sample-wise balanced label shuffle within source fitting role; preserve original stored labels. A global class-ID renaming is not a feature-transfer negative control.

negative_control_registration_needed: Before fitting, freeze the source-only synthetic training-target assignment and source-selection policy/digest for the shuffle task. Original development label records and all target labels stay untouched. The shuffle breaks sample-label association in the control; it does not create new ground truth or label-role memberships.

matching_limits.first_two: Same model capacity, source/target inputs, per-stage update counts, label exposure, seed and selection schedule; source semantic supervision differs
matching_limits.third: Only target adaptation budget matched; transfer pretraining cost additional and reported
matching_limits.fourth: Total optimizer-step count matched; differing source/target band dimensions prevent an unmeasured equal-FLOP or equal-wall-time claim

source_update_reuse_accounting: Count unique source fits once when reused, and report inherited source cost per target. Do not count model seeds as independent acquisition geographies.
selection: Freeze source/target development CE NLL event schedule and first-min tie rule before fit. No test/query selection, no mid-run tuning.
efficacy_claim: None. K5/V5 and three model seeds are a development screen, not proof of power, convergence, geographic independence or sensor causality.
runtime_estimate_status: Pending a measured profile of the final admitted common-head/native input mapping. Historical shape costs are planning context only.
